Anaconda, our new parent company, is among them . NVIDIA’s Jensen Huang announced the coalition behind it in his first ever post on X. It was a good week for open. Now, we’re bringing the data to back up the need for an open ecosystem. Kilo doesn’t make models. We don’t host them, we don’t train on or retain your data.
